# MM-P1-L4-HP02 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #2
Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L4-HP02

## Scope
This document defines preventive and corrective maintenance tasks for the Heat Treat hydraulic forging press EQ-P1-L4-HP02. It covers mechanical fastening verification, hydraulic system pressure limit verification, and functional checks necessary to return the press to service after maintenance. For operating procedures and lockout-tagout, see SOP-P1-L4-01, SOP-P1-L4-02, and SOP-P1-L4-03.

## Tools
- Torque wrench capable of reaching the main ram bolt torque specified below.
- Hydraulic pressure gauge compatible with machine test ports.
- Standard hand tools and safety equipment per site PPE policy.

## Procedure
- Verify area is secured and procedures in SOP-P1-L4-01 and SOP-P1-L4-02 are followed prior to entry.
- Isolate hydraulic power and relieve residual pressure following SOP-P1-L4-03.
- Inspect the main ram and surrounding bolted joints for visible damage or displacement.
- Using the torque wrench, set and apply the main ram bolt torque for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 to 970 N·m. Confirm each relevant fastener reaches the specified torque and document readings.
- Install the hydraulic pressure gauge at the designated test port. Restore hydraulic power and monitor system pressure while operating controls at minimal demand. Verify the system pressure limit for EQ-P1-L4-HP02 does not exceed 300 bar during test cycles.
- If pressure approaches or exceeds the specified limit, stop operation immediately, isolate the system, and execute troubleshooting per SOP-P1-L4-02 and SOP-P1-L4-03.
- After tests, remove test equipment, restore system to standard configuration, and complete maintenance record entries.

## Acceptance criteria
- All main ram bolts torqued to 970 N·m and recorded in the maintenance log.
- Operational pressure validated and confirmed not to exceed 300 bar under test conditions.
- No abnormal leaks, noises, or visible deformations observed during functional test.
- Work order closed with references to SOP-P1-L4-01, SOP-P1-L4-02, and SOP-P1-L4-03 and signature of the technician and supervisor.
